author: LewdieLewis
quote:
This feels less like GTA but more like a Sims game. I do not know why, who and what direction the developers and producers were doing, why did they not look into the previous games of why they were a success.

Issue with this game, there are predestrians who are 'protected' from being shot and buildings such as the dance clubs where you can't even shoot up, GTA Vice City allowed this by the way.

This game played it too safe and they should of had guts regarding the current climate.
0 / 10
